verdict.rationale: AutoGen is an agent-building framework whose components (AssistantAgent, teams) act as MCP *clients* — e.g. the docs example of an agent using the Playwright MCP server (autogen-gh-2) is client-side tool consumption, not AutoGen exposing an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Serving as an MCP server is a different product role than what AutoGen ships or documents, so this axis does not apply.
